comparison_families.description: All 28 pairs in the eight-judge all-at-once Top-1 band.
GPT-5.5 against the five registered no-LLM entrants.
Exec-rank against position on Top-1, Top-3, and MRR.
All-at-once against two alternatives for ten cached judges.
Seven prespecified POST detection AUC contrasts.
Four prespecified contrasts at the first SWE-Gym prefix.
Auditable against ECOD at the three later SWE-Gym prefixes.
Exploratory family added after its scores were examined: twenty nonrandom SWE-Gym method-prefix cells against 0.70, two-sided.
Auditable against ECOD at all four tau-bench prefixes.
Twenty nonrandom tau method-prefix cells against 0.70, two-sided.
Three primary Gold localization Top-1 claims.
Two Gold attribution features against chance.
Seven pooled rule-based PRE methods against flag-all.
Pooled combined PRE scanner against the held-out judge.
Selection-aware best non-oracle PRE candidate against flag-all in six sources.
Three narrow PRE rules' precision against the capability base rate.
